description:
From: Elixir Parity. Approved by the user 2026-11-24 ("Land body now, guards as ticket", relayed by Elixir Parity). Split from fz-j8z, which lands Kernel.binary_part/3 for bodies only.

Today: def f(b) when binary_part(b, 1, 2) == "bc" fails with lower/unsupported 'helper binary_part/3 is not dispatch-pure and cannot be reified into guard dispatch'. Guard evaluation carries a binary only as its byte count, and GuardExtern returns only int/float/ref/bool (src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:312).

Change: binary-valued guard results on interp, run and build. A design page comes before building.

P3: json.erl uses binary_part only in bodies.

Done when: the guard above selects its clause as in Elixir on all three paths (oracle fixture).
title: binary_part/3 is usable in guards, as in Elixir
